content.short: Japanese interest-based social network with a crypto layer and World ID verification.
content.description: Yay! is a social app where people find others through shared interests such as anime, games and language learning, in Circles and timelines across Japanese, English, Korean, Thai and other languages. It added a Web3 side with the YAY token, staking, NFTs like the Yay Prime Pass and airdrops, and integrated World ID to keep communities human. World App users can reach its communities from inside the wallet.
content.meta: Find friends by shared interests on Yay!, a Japanese social network with the YAY token and World ID verification.
